EmailTemplate.name: QTP-Beneficiary Designation Report
EmailTemplate.subject: Beneficiary Designation Report
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello [client],
The Beneficiary Designation Report identifies whether an employee has designated a beneficiary under Insperity's Basic Group Life Insurance policy. It is available to your employees who have the Benefits Reporting role through Web Reporting on Insperity Premier.
This is report is helpful during open enrollment or throughout the year to remind employees to update their beneficiary when making annual benefits elections or when they experience a qualifying life event such as marriage, divorce or birth of a child.
You can navigate to this report by selecting Benefits from the Reporting Dashboard on Insperity Premier within the Reporting Center, then selecting Beneficiary Designation report.
The report includes the following information:
Beneficiary designation (Yes/No) Employee name, ID and email address Employee classification status Employee eligibility status Signature date (date of latest designation)
Note: The report lists active employees as of the date it is run. This information does not include beneficiary information for Voluntary Life Insurance (employee-paid).
I have attached instructions for employees who need to designate or change their beneficiary. They can call the Contact Center if they have any questions about these changes.
Thank you for trusting Insperity to serve your business.
[signature]
